focus: پیشرفته ۱ · جلسه شانزدهم · Do you by any chance

conversation: A: Do you by any chance know when the American president is gonna arrive?
B: Yes, as far as I know he is gonna arrive at 2:30
A: Somehow I thought the American's president was gonna arrive earlier.
B: Yes, I am positive. He arrives at 2:30.
